task: fix(project-name): a reaped or husk worktree resolves to its repo by name
accept: a reaped worktree under the worktree root resolves to its repo by name
a husk dir (no .git, Logs only) resolves the same way, from a subdir too
the longest registered repo name wins
a name that only shares a prefix without the dash is not claimed
the same name OUTSIDE the worktree root keeps its basename
a live worktree still resolves through git, not its name

cmd: [ -e tests/vendor ] || ln -s "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/../tests/vendor" tests/vendor; exec tests/vendor/bats-core/bin/bats "$@"

^(a reaped worktree under the worktree root resolves to its repo by name|a husk dir \(no \.git, Logs only\) resolves the same way, from a subdir too|the longest registered repo name wins|a name that only shares a prefix without the dash is not claimed|the same name OUTSIDE the worktree root keeps its basename|a live worktree still resolves through git, not its name)$
